title: Shared definitions
description: Identifiers and small value types reused by every DRPG schema.

ref.description: Stable reference to a catalog entry: '<system>/<kind>/<slug>' for official content, 'custom/<owner>/<kind>/<slug>' for homebrew. Links between entries always use refs, never names.

identifier.description: Machine name used inside a system registry (abilities, skills, damage types, events...).

registry_name.description: Dotted name of a registered variable, predicate, event or stat. The first segment must be declared in the system's registry; later segments are parameters (e.g. 'ability_mod.str', 'class_level.barbarian').

text.description: Verbatim source text in the extraction's markdown conventions.

action_cost.description: Part of the action economy an activation consumes. Values are declared in system.action_economy; 'none' means no cost.

json_pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer inside the same entry (e.g. '/effects/0/on_fail/1').
